name: Fivenson Reviews Widget for Google Business
author: fivensonstudiosinc

sections.description:
Fivenson Reviews Widget for Google Business allows you to display authentic customer reviews from your Google Business Profile on any WordPress site. Reviews are supplied by a JSON feed you maintain or specify; the plugin renders and formats the feed with responsive touch sliders, carousels, and grid layouts.

Created by Chris Narine-Fivenson at Fivenson Studios.

Designed for performance, reliability, and visitor trust:
* Interactive Carousel & Slider: Smooth auto-scrolling card slider with touch finger swipe, mouse grab-and-drag, and circular navigation buttons.
* Sort by Newest 1st: Chronological ordering ensures your newest, freshest customer reviews are displayed prominently.
* Responsive Grid & List Feed: Complete reviews feed with high-impact rating summary badge, “Write a review” call to action, and “Load More” pagination.
* SEO Rich Snippets (Schema.org): Built-in LocalBusiness AggregateRating structured data injection for organic Google star snippets.
* Secure Client Architecture: Zero client-side API key exposure. Front-end DOM rendering uses safe text node creation and sanitized attributes.
* Star Filtering: Easily filter out low ratings (e.g. show only 3, 4, or 5-star reviews).
* Lightweight & Fast: Pure vanilla JS and scoped CSS with zero bulky dependencies.
* Visual Shortcode Generator: Built-in copy-and-paste tool for Elementor, Gutenberg, and classic editors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fivenson-business-reviews-for-google folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Fivenson Reviews to enter your Google Place ID and customize your preferences.
  4. Place the shortcode [fivenson_reviews layout="slider" sort="newest" min_rating="3"] anywhere on your site.
sections.faq:
How do I find my Google Place ID?

You can find your Place ID using Google’s Place ID Finder tool or entering your business name in the plugin settings.

Can I hide reviews under 3 stars?

Yes, you can set the min_rating attribute or configure it in the admin settings. Reviews below your threshold are filtered out.

Can visitors swipe with their fingers on mobile?

Yes! The carousel supports full touch swipe on mobile and mouse grab-and-drag on desktop.

Does this expose my Google Cloud API keys?

No. The plugin is built with a zero-credential client architecture to prevent quota theft and key abuse.

Does this plugin inject Google SEO Schema?

Yes. Enabling the SEO & Schema setting outputs Schema.org AggregateRating markup into the page header for Google search rich snippets.

How are reviews synchronized?

Reviews are supplied by a JSON feed URL you configure under Settings > Fivenson Reviews (or an endpoint you maintain). The plugin renders the feed with responsive sliders, touch gestures, and star filtering without exposing Google API credentials in client-side code.

Where can I get support or request features?

For support or inquiries, contact info@fivensonstudios.com or visit https://fivensonstudios.com.
sections.changelog:
1.1.6

  • Privacy & Data Protection: Replaced bundled client reviews with generic anonymized sample data.
  • Configuration Defaults: Cleared all client-specific defaults for Place ID, business name, and review URLs.
  • Schema & SEO Compliance: AggregateRating structured data is now dynamically derived from validated feed data; omitted when unsubstantiated to comply with Google search guidelines.
  • Schema Default: Disabled schema output by default to prevent conflicts with dedicated SEO plugins.
  • Compatibility: Added backward-compatibility alias for the [trust_reviews] shortcode.

1.1.5

  • Renamed plugin display name to “Fivenson Reviews Widget for Google Business” per WordPress.org reviewer recommendation.
  • Synchronized all internationalization gettext functions to text domain “fivenson-business-reviews-for-google”.
  • Standardized all prefixes to “fivenson_reviews” (minimum 4+ characters) across defines, options, and shortcodes.
  • Removed legacy shortcodes and 3-letter constants.

1.1.0

  • Added chronological sorting with “Newest first” as default.
  • Added touch swipe on mobile and mouse grab-and-drag on desktop with inertia snap.
  • Added comprehensive 5-tab WordPress admin settings suite.
  • Added Schema.org LocalBusiness AggregateRating JSON-LD integration for SEO rich snippets.
  • Added interactive Shortcode Generator tool in admin settings.
  • Added brand accent color customizer.
  • Added uninstall.php cleanup script for official WordPress.org repository compliance.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release with slider, list, star filtering, and secure rendering.
